text: {"lessons":["Selling winners feels rewarding, but I should not let the satisfaction of locking in gains dictate decisions; consider each stock’s future prospects and portfolio role.","My partial sales in B and C reduced exposure, yet account value still fell; selling some shares does not eliminate the risk in what I continue to hold.","After periods with no trades, I should still review risk and diversification rather than assume that holding is automatically the right choice."]}
